html:
Careers

Data Analyst

Location Mirik, Darjeeling
Experience 0 to 3 Years
Team Research, Data & Insights

Turn Information Into Action

Data is only valuable when it helps people make better decisions.

At Studio 1947, we work across research, community development, technology, sustainability, innovation, and business projects. We're looking for a Data Analyst who enjoys discovering patterns, finding insights, and transforming complex information into meaningful stories.

You'll help teams and clients understand what's working, what isn't, and what opportunities lie ahead.

What You'll Do

  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze datasets.
  • Build dashboards, reports, and visualizations.
  • Support research and impact assessment projects.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to answer strategic questions.
  • Prepare presentations and data-driven recommendations.
  • Ensure data quality and accuracy across projects.
  • Contribute to monitoring, evaluation, and reporting activities.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Comfort working with numbers and datasets.
  • Ability to communicate findings clearly and effectively.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Curiosity and a problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to translate data into practical recommendations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, or R.
  • Experience in research, surveys, or impact assessment.
  • Understanding of statistics and data visualisation.

Why Join Studio 1947?

You'll work on projects that go beyond business metrics. From community programs and research studies to technology products and innovation initiatives, your insights will help shape decisions that create real-world impact.

Ready to Apply?

Share your CV, portfolio, dashboards, case studies, academic projects, or any examples that showcase your analytical thinking.
